{{Quote|Go back to your temple&mdash;our orbital patrols will get him!|Noana Sowrs to Lucien Draay, regarding Zayne Carrick|<ref name="KotOR3" />}}
The '''Taris Civil Authority police cruiser''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] used around [[3964 BBY]] by the [[Taris Civil Authority]], the law enforcement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was capable of following fugitives into [[Realspace/Legends|space]]; whereas the [[Taris Civil Authority gunship|craft]] used planetside on Taris could not. At least three were used to attempt to apprehend the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Marn Hierogryph]], the falsely accused perpetrators of the [[Padawan Massacre]] of Taris.

==Characteristics==
The police [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was capable of traveling in the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and were armed but required clearance from the [[Sector Constable]] to use their weapons lethally.<ref name="KotOR3" /><ref name="KotOR4" /> A large blue searchlight was mounted on the front of the cruisers to help improve visibility.<ref name="KotOR5">[[Knights of the Old Republic 5|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 5]]</ref>

One particular feature of the cruisers was a "hover mode" that allowed all occupants of the cruiser to disembark while keeping the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] nearby.<ref name="KotOR5" /> This was particularly useful when low-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] environments made landing difficult.<ref name="Faraway">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor05.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #5''}}</ref>

==Role==
The police cruiser was used by the [[Taris Civil Authority]], the law enforcement on the planet of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], to follow fugitives into space.<ref name="KotOR4" /> The cruiser was needed because the [[Taris Civil Authority gunship|craft]] used [[Planet/Legends|planetside]] were unable to go into space.<ref name="KotOR3" /> If required, the cruiser would fire upon fugitive ships to destroy them.<ref name="KotOR4" />

==History==
The police cruiser was used by the Taris Civil Authority around [[3964 BBY]]. A notable deployment of the cruisers was when the [[Taris Civil Authority]] and the [[Jedi Covenant]] issued an arrest warrant for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Marn Hierogryph|Marn "Gryph" Hierogryph]] for their alleged involvement in the [[Padawan Massacre]] of Taris. In an effort to escape offworld from the Civil Authority, Hierogryph decided to call on the [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian Offshoot]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Gorman Vandrayk|Gorman "Camper" Vandrayk]] and his companion [[Jarael]] for help. An arrest [[Squad/Legends|squad]] led by [[Sector Constable]] [[Noana Sowrs]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lucien Draay]] arrived soon after the fugitives found Vandrayk and Jarael. Vandrayk ultimately decided to take them inside his modified starship, [[The Last Resort (starship)|''The Last Resort'']], and attempt to leave the planet. The Taris Civil Authority were not expecting the fugitives to flee to space and did not have craft capable of following. Sowrs assured Draay, both aboard a Civil Authority [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], that the police cruisers would be able to apprehend ''The Last Resort''.<ref name="KotOR3" />

Unreliable repairs made to ''The Last Resort'' caused it to stop in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet, where three of the police cruisers surrounded the ship. Sector Constable Sowrs authorized these cruisers to use lethal force if necessary. Vandrayk managed to fix his ship's systems and it suddenly sped off into the [[Taris asteroid belt|Tarisian asteroid belt]], hitting one of the police cruisers in the process. After deciding to look for [[T1-LB]], an [[LB-series bulk-loading droid]] that was used by the masters of the [[Jedi Tower]] to set up portable shields for them to meditate under safely, Carrick and Jarael were dropped off where the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was last seen&mdash;Taris' [[Rogue Moon]].<ref name="KotOR4" />

[[File:TCAcruiserresistance.jpg|thumb|200px|A TCA cruiser in the Lower City base of the Taris Resistance]]
The duo found the droid at the foot of a cliff, having been [[Telekinesis/Legends|pushed]] off with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by Draay. They then suddenly found themselves confronted with said Master, who had navigated through the asteroid belt in a police cruiser with several Civil Authority officers to find them. However, the empty police cruiser was shot down by Hierogryph in ''The Last Resort'', as the Snivvian had discovered that Vandrayk had rerouted the power from the hyperdrive to "one beauty of a gun."<ref name="KotOR5" /> During the [[Taris Siege|Siege of Taris]], a cruiser was located in the [[Lower City]] base of the [[Taris Resistance]].<ref name="KotOR22" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Taris Civil Authority police cruiser was first mentioned in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 3|third issue]] of the [[2006]] [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The issue was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="KotOR3" /> on [[March 29]], [[2006]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-878/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-3|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #3}}</ref> The cruiser made its first appearance in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 4|following issue]], written by Miller, illustrated by [[Brian Ching]], and published by Dark Horse<ref name="KotOR4" /> on [[April 26]] of the same year.<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-890/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-4|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #4}}</ref>
